RT @ SebGorka President @ realDonaldTrump was and is right. This is the fate of incumbents and his results are better than most Presidents, especially Obama and Clinton. 
 Being a Chicken Little may get you clicks, but I prefer the Truth. 
 Here’s data from the American Presidency Project on net Congressional changes for an incumbent President’s party: 
 • 1938 (Truman D): −79 
• 1946 (Truman D): −68
• 1958 (Eisenhower R): −61
• 1966 (Johnson D): −51
• 1974 (Ford R): −53
• 1978 (Carter D): −15
• 1982 (Reagan R): −25
• 1994 (Clinton D): −63
• 2006 (G.W. Bush R): −30
• 2010 (Obama D): −69
 If anyone you follow is calling Tuesday’s results “historic” or “unprecedented,” they’re ignorant or liars and you shouldn’t waste your time with them. 
 @ WhiteHouse
